name: Maison Noir Structured Tote
shortDescription: Hand-stitched full-grain Italian leather with polished gold hardware
description:
The Maison Noir Structured Tote is the centrepiece of the Maison Elara debut collection. Crafted from full-grain Italian vegetable-tanned leather, each bag ages with its owner — developing a rich, personal patina over time.

The interior is lined in ivory silk-twill with two slip pockets and a central zip compartment. The reinforced base protects the structure, while the polished 24K gold-plated brass hardware adds an understated elegance that defines modern luxury.

• Full-grain vegetable-tanned Italian leather
• 24K gold-plated brass hardware
• Silk-twill interior lining
• Magnetic snap closure with concealed zip
• Comes with authenticity card and dust bag
